text:
## Enhanced Due Diligence for High-Risk Customers  
A high-risk customer must receive enhanced due diligence before the account is
activated or an exception is approved.  
| Control | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Beneficial ownership | For entity customers, identify and verify every beneficial owner with more than 25% ownership or control |
| Source of funds | Obtain and assess evidence for an initial deposit above £10,000 |
| Screening | Screen OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media sources |
| Approval | Head of Compliance approval before activation; CRO approval for any policy exception |
| Ongoing monitoring | Review high-risk customers at least quarterly rather than annually |

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Due Diligence for High-Risk Customers
raw_entities.description: Policy mandating enhanced due diligence procedures for high-risk customers prior to account activation or exception approval. Establishes requirements for beneficial ownership verification, source of funds assessment, multi-source screening, and ongoing monitoring at elevated frequency.
context: A high-risk customer must receive enhanced due diligence before the account is activated or an exception is approved.
Enhanced Due Diligence for High-Risk Customers

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Identification and Verification
raw_entities.description: Requirement to identify and verify every beneficial owner of entity customers with more than 25% ownership or control. Applies to all high-risk entity customers undergoing enhanced due diligence.
context: For entity customers, identify and verify every beneficial owner with more than 25% ownership or control

raw_entities.name: Source of Funds Assessment for Initial Deposits
raw_entities.description: Requirement to obtain and assess evidence for initial deposits exceeding £10,000 from high-risk customers. Establishes a monetary threshold triggering enhanced source of funds documentation.
context: Obtain and assess evidence for an initial deposit above £10,000

raw_entities.name: Multi-Source Sanctions and PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: Requirement to screen high-risk customers against OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP lists, sanctions databases, and adverse-media sources. Establishes the screening sources and scope for high-risk customer due diligence.
context: Screen OFAC, EU, UN, HMT, PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media sources

raw_entities.name: Head of Compliance Approval for Account Activation
raw_entities.description: Requirement that the Head of Compliance must approve account activation for high-risk customers after enhanced due diligence is completed. Establishes the approval gate and responsible role.
context: Head of Compliance approval before activation

raw_entities.name: Chief Risk Officer Approval for Policy Exceptions
raw_entities.description: Requirement that the Chief Risk Officer must approve any policy exception for high-risk customers. Establishes escalation authority for deviations from standard enhanced due diligence requirements.
context: CRO approval for any policy exception

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Ongoing Monitoring for High-Risk Customers
raw_entities.description: Requirement to review high-risk customers at least quarterly rather than annually. Establishes elevated monitoring frequency for high-risk customer accounts post-activation.
context: Review high-risk customers at least quarterly rather than annually
